Vector control intervention for an OpenMalaria scenario

Source: R/xml_export.R
get_OM_GVI_snippet.Rd

Builds the generic vector intervention (GVI) parameters of an OpenMalaria scenario (schema 44) from an intervention object, as the input list of openMalariaUtilities::defineVectorControl(). Each effect (deterrency, pre-prandial and post-prandial killing) becomes an OpenMalaria component with its own decay.

Values are the initial efficacies. The decay of each effect is the product of attrition and its insecticide decay, exported exactly when it is a single OpenMalaria decay shape and approximated otherwise:

  • no insecticide decay for the effect (or insecticide_decay = FALSE): the attrition decay;

  • no attrition (decay_attrition = "none", e.g. IRS): the effect's insecticide decay (component_decay, or linear from halflife_insecticide);

  • both (e.g. nets with insecticide decay): the Weibull fitted to their product (fitted_decay of build_intervention, starting at 1 as OpenMalaria's decays).

A negative halflife_insecticide (efficacy increasing with washing) has no OpenMalaria shape: it is only exported through the fitted Weibull (with attrition), and is an error without attrition. Decay parameters L are converted from days to years. As OpenMalaria has no separate attrition for GVIs, net attrition is folded into the decay of the effects.

The effects act on the mosquito populations exposed to the intervention (see get_OM_ento_snippet): in bed for ITNs, resting indoors for IRS (or biting indoors, with get_OM_ento_snippet(irs_exposure = "indoor_biting")); other populations get propActive = 0. Use the same choice for the exposure of calculate_impact() (see calculate_exposure). Without the split (get_OM_ento_snippet() without activity), the intervention acts on all the bites of every population, outdoor bites included, with a warning (here, in define_OM_vector_control and in get_OM_xml).

Dummy-host interventions (KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute) have no pre-prandial killing: their GVI has deterrency and post-prandial killing only, and the host-seeking killing, which has no GVI equivalent, is not part of this snippet (nor of add_OM_GVI), and a warning says so: it is written by define_OM_vector_control + deploy_OM_vector_control, or get_OM_xml.

Usage

get_OM_GVI_snippet(
  interv,
  om_ento,
  intervention_type = c("ITN", "IRS"),
  name = NULL
)

Arguments

interv

Intervention from om_vector_control (or an object from build_intervention).

om_ento

Output of get_OM_ento_snippet.

intervention_type

"ITN" (acts in bed) or "IRS" (acts on indoor resting mosquitoes, or indoor biting ones with get_OM_ento_snippet(irs_exposure = "indoor_biting")).

name

Name of the intervention (default: the name of an om_vector_control() specification, else the description of a build_intervention() object unless "custom", else "GVI").

Value

Named list (one element, name) with deterrency, preprandialKillingEffect (standard model only) and postprandialKillingEffect, each with decay and per-mosquito anophelesParams (propActive, value), for defineVectorControl(vectorInterventionParameters = ).

See also

get_OM_ento_snippet, build_intervention

Examples

itn = om_vector_control(
    c(Deterrency = 0.5, PrePrandial = 0.4, PostPrandial = 0.3),
    halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2, name = "ITN")
om  = get_OM_ento_snippet("Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii",
                          activity = def_activity_patterns())
#> get_OM_ento_snippet: annualEIR = a placeholder @contrib_<population>@ for the relative contribution of each population (values: om_ento_values()); set the total EIR with scaledAnnualEIR (e.g. defineEntomology(..., scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@")).
gvi = get_OM_GVI_snippet(itn, om, intervention_type = "ITN")
str(gvi$ITN$deterrency$decay)
#> List of 3
#>  $ L       : chr "2"
#>  $ function: chr "weibull"
#>  $ k       : chr "2"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
baseList = openMalariaUtilities::defineVectorControl(baseList, gvi)
} # }
